text:
Looking at this question: "top 5 customers by revenue" — a ranking of customers by revenue, no qualifier scoping it to beverage/food/order-total.

Per the Revenue term, there are two distinct governed definitions that both plausibly apply here: gross order revenue (order_total, includes tax) at the orders grain, and lifetime customer spend (lifetime_spend / lifetime_spend_pretax) at the customer grain. Since "revenue" for customers isn't a single named metric but the business term explicitly distinguishes order-level (tax-inclusive) vs product-level (pretax) treatment, and the customer entity has its own lifetime spend metrics with a pretax/gross split, this is material to the answer.
